import shelve
from dataclasses import dataclass, field


@dataclass(match_args=False)
class DisabledMatchArgs:
    shelf: shelve.Shelf[str]


@dataclass(kw_only=True)
class KeywordOnly:
    shelf: shelve.Shelf[str]


@dataclass
class ExcludedFields:
    without_init: shelve.Shelf[str] = field(init=False)
    keyword_only: shelve.Shelf[str] = field(kw_only=True)


def inspect_disabled(value: DisabledMatchArgs) -> None:
    match value:
        case DisabledMatchArgs({"decision": decision}):
            pass


def inspect_keyword_only(value: KeywordOnly) -> None:
    match value:
        case KeywordOnly({"decision": decision}):
            pass


def inspect_excluded(value: ExcludedFields) -> None:
    match value:
        case ExcludedFields({"decision": decision}):
            pass
